C0302.title: Real-Time Detection and Defense Algorithm for CC Attacks Based on Information Entropy
C0302.summary: This 2012 conference paper proposes an information-entropy-based algorithm for real-time CC attack detection and defense, including attack detection, attack-source identification, and connection blocking. It describes CC attacks as application-layer denial-of-service attacks that consume server resources through large numbers of forged HTTP requests.

references.title: An Algorithm of Detecting and Defending CC Attack in Real Time
